neighbours.label: the laughter interjection 'Ha'/'ha' (Ha!, ha-ha, ha ha), as against other interjections and exclamations
fire: I finally beat my brother at chess. Ha! He was furious.
She read the note and burst out, ha-ha, that is brilliant.
You thought I would forget your birthday? Ha, not a chance.
He slipped on the ice right in front of us. Ha ha, poor guy.
My code compiled on the first try. Ha! Never happens.
Mario grinned and said: I did, ha-ha, every single time.
The cat knocked the cup off the table again, ha.
And then the boss wore the costume to the meeting. Ha!
quiet: I finally beat my brother at chess. Wow! He was furious.
She read the note and burst out, oh my, that is brilliant.
You thought I would forget your birthday? Well, not a chance.
He slipped on the ice right in front of us. Ouch, poor guy.
My code compiled on the first try. Yes! Never happens.
Mario grinned and said: I did, of course, every single time.
The cat knocked the cup off the table again, sadly.
And then the boss wore the costume to the meeting. Seriously!

notes: Not probed (the plan was drafted for the - pole by mistake, caught before fill). Card + pole: ' Ha'/'Ha'/'ha' x13 of top 32, also tokens just before 'haem-'/'hem-' words (' of', ' In', ' for'), which this test does not cover.
